name: Transient light curves (classification, SN score)
description: Classify transient light curves (SN Ia / Ibc / II, fast transient, AGN, periodic variable, static residual) with a random forest trained on a synthetic library, give a calibrated SN score, optionally using the host offset; link the results to catalog objects. Works on a light-curve table or on the Moving-objects light curves.

params.name: source
params.label: Light curves from
params.help: file = long-form table (id, mjd, flux or mag, error; optional number, ra, dec, host_offset_re); moving = the Moving-objects work directory (lightcurves.json + transients.tsv).

params.name: lc-file
params.label: Light-curve table
params.help: TSV or CSV; several light curves in one file, grouped by the id column.

params.name: moving-dir
params.label: Moving-objects work directory
params.help: Directory with lightcurves.json (Light Curve step) and transients.tsv.

params.name: flux-unit
params.label: Table values
params.help: auto = flux if a flux column exists, else magnitudes (AB).

params.name: zp
params.label: Flux zero point (AB)
params.help: Fluxes are put on the zero point 25 scale used by the classifier.

params.name: link
params.label: Link light curves to catalog objects
params.help: number = number / host_id column (or numeric id); position = nearest catalog object to ra/dec; auto = number first, then position.

params.name: min-prob
params.label: Minimum class probability
params.help: Below it the class is "unclassified" (the best guess stays in the results table).

params.name: no-host
params.label: Ignore the host offset
params.help: By default light curves that carry host_offset_re / offset_re (offset in R_e) use the host-offset model (nuclear offsets favour AGN).
